svg.desc: Training curves use no test labels. Each confusion matrix has actual classes as rows and predicted classes as columns, with forty test examples of each class. Training loss and held-out error are distinct evidence. Fixed architecture and settings were not selected by the test score.
svg.title: Training objectives and held-out confusion counts
